title: OAuth2/OIDC misconfiguration runner: detect redirect_uri bypass, PKCE absence, state parameter missing, and token leakage
goal: OAuth2/OIDC is the authentication backbone of modern applications. Misconfigurations lead to account takeover. This is not covered by any current runner. Implement an oauth-probe runner: (1) Discovery: detect OAuth2 endpoints by looking for /oauth/authorize, /oauth/token, /.well-known/openid-configuration, authorization_code patterns in JavaScript, and social login buttons. (2) redirect_uri bypass: test if the authorization server accepts: wildcard subdomains (https://evil.legitimate.com), path traversal (https://legit.com/../evil), open redirect chains as redirect URIs. Finding: 'OAuth2 Redirect URI Bypass — Account Takeover Possible'. (3) State parameter CSRF: check if the state parameter is present in authorization requests. If absent → OAuth CSRF (attacker can link their account to victim). (4) PKCE absent for SPAs: check if single-page app OAuth flows use PKCE (code_challenge). Absent PKCE in SPA → authorization code interception possible. (5) Token in URL: check if access tokens appear in URL fragments or redirect parameters (visible in browser history, referrer headers). (6) Token scope over-provisioning: request minimal scope, check if returned token grants broader access. (7) Implicit flow still supported: check if implicit flow (response_type=token) is enabled (deprecated, insecure). Active tier. Tool: custom Python using requests + browser automation. WIZARD WIRING (mandatory): (1) Add to api/app/services/run_profiles.py: name=active-web-oauth-probe, run_class=ACTIVE, tools=[oauth-probe], required_approvals=1, approval_step_id: active-web-oauth-probe. (2) Add profile active-web-oauth-probe to FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB Phase 2 in api/app/services/assessment_chain.py. (3) Add to wizard.js resolveExecutionProfile: when Web or API tile + active or full, include active-web-oauth-probe in planned profiles. (4) Add to scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP: active-web-oauth-probe: [oauth-probe].
scope: OAuth2/OIDC misconfigurations are in every major pentest standard (WSTG-SESS-10, OWASP Testing Guide). Not covered by any current runner. Critical for SaaS applications with 'Login with Google/Microsoft' or API-backed authentication.
generation_reason: OAuth2/OIDC testing absent from AegisPT — redirect_uri bypass, missing PKCE, token leakage are common real-world findings in modern SaaS applications.
